artifact_observations.reasoning: Critical logical failure: The traffic light displays both Red and Green lights simultaneously. In real-world traffic engineering, this is physically impossible due to interlock mechanisms. This indicates the AI failed to understand the mutual exclusivity constraint of the object's function.
The top lens is unlit but lacks the expected deep red coloration of an inactive red lens; it appears somewhat muddy or dark grey, blending too much with the housing shadow.
The background is a uniform, noisy, dark reddish-brown gradient that lacks any environmental context (sky, street, poles), typical of AI isolation artifacts.
